Theorem
[heat-kernel parametrix] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0341 1. ch16:16.12\group Heat Kernel Bounds

For a complete manifold and its minimal positive heat kernel, \[ H(x,y,\tau )\sim (4\pi \tau )^{-n/2}e^{-d(x,y)^2/(4\tau )} \sum _{j=0}^{\infty }\tau ^ju_j(x,y,\tau ), \] locally uniformly with the standard remainder estimates and $u_0(x,x,0)=1$.
